takeaways: Copilot value depends more on human behavior and showing people how it helps their own work than on features or governance.
Better results come from clear expectations in prompts, the right model choice and personalization settings such as custom instructions, meeting recap templates and Copilot memory.
Successful adoption uses excited champions per department and organization-specific prompt galleries to create quick, visible wins.
hook: Many companies buy Copilot licenses and still struggle to see real productivity gains. In this conversation, Microsoft MVP and LinkedIn Learning instructor Jess Stratton shares how business users and adoption leads can move beyond prompt engineering. Learn how personalization, better expectations, prompt galleries and departmental champions make Copilot work the way you work.
